description: com.apple.WebKit.custom-pasteboard-data from the macOS general pasteboard
how: Opened file:///private/tmp/rclip-capture/page.html (h1, a paragraph with bold/italic and a link, a 3-row bordered table), used the Find bar to move focus into the page, then Edit > Select All, Edit > Copy.
notes: REDACTED. WebKit's per-copy pasteboard origin token: a length-prefixed "null:<uuid>" string, zero-padded to 66 bytes. The UUID was replaced in place with 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000, the same 36 bytes, so every offset in the record still holds. It is a fresh random value per copy and identifies nothing outside the session that produced it.
